title: Build a double-ended queue (Deque) in Python
description: Greenfield Python task: implement a Deque class with append, appendleft, pop, popleft, peek, peek_left, is_empty, and __len__ methods. Raises IndexError on pop/peek of empty deque.

injections.content:
import pytest
from src.deque import Deque


def test_append_pop():
    d = Deque()
    d.append(1)
    d.append(2)
    assert d.pop() == 2
    assert d.pop() == 1


def test_appendleft_popleft():
    d = Deque()
    d.appendleft(1)
    d.appendleft(2)
    assert d.popleft() == 2
    assert d.popleft() == 1


def test_peek():
    d = Deque()
    d.append(10)
    d.append(20)
    assert d.peek() == 20
    assert len(d) == 2


def test_peek_left():
    d = Deque()
    d.append(1)
    d.append(2)
    assert d.peek_left() == 1
    assert len(d) == 2


def test_is_empty():
    d = Deque()
    assert d.is_empty()
    d.append(1)
    assert not d.is_empty()


def test_len():
    d = Deque()
    d.append(1)
    d.appendleft(2)
    d.append(3)
    assert len(d) == 3


def test_pop_empty_raises():
    d = Deque()
    with pytest.raises(IndexError):
        d.pop()


def test_popleft_empty_raises():
    d = Deque()
    with pytest.raises(IndexError):
        d.popleft()


def test_mixed_operations():
    d = Deque()
    d.append(3)
    d.appendleft(1)
    d.append(4)
    # internal order: [1, 3, 4]
    assert d.popleft() == 1
    assert d.pop() == 4
    assert len(d) == 1
    assert d.peek() == 3
    assert d.peek_left() == 3

task_spec.prompt:
Implement Deque in src/deque.py.

class Deque:
    def __init__(self)
    def append(self, item)        # add to right end
    def appendleft(self, item)   # add to left end
    def pop(self) -> any          # remove from right; raise IndexError if empty
    def popleft(self) -> any     # remove from left;  raise IndexError if empty
    def peek(self) -> any         # view right end without removing; raise IndexError if empty
    def peek_left(self) -> any   # view left end without removing;  raise IndexError if empty
    def is_empty(self) -> bool
    def __len__(self) -> int

All 9 tests in tests/test_deque.py must pass.

pop removes from right, popleft removes from left
